name: Oil vs Acrylic
imagesNote: Most concept images are details of public-domain paintings and prints; four are diagrams made for this site, and one is John Rand's 1841 paint-tube patent drawing. The example paintings are public domain, except two acrylics by David Nicholson.
ldDescription: A short course comparing oil and acrylic paint.
homeDescription: {name}: how oil and acrylic paint differ, from their binders and drying to open time, blending, impasto, painting over and aging, shown with diagrams and paintings.
